name: Prohis
summary: Bluff smuggling game where players run hidden convoys, inspect rivals, and bribe inspectors to get goods to their warehouse.
rules_text: Each player starts with a Captain, a Major and 4 goods/Prohi cards. Central draw has a deck and 4 faceup cards. On your turn you must either draw or create a convoy. Draw: take 2 faceup, or 1 faceup+1 facedown, or 1 faceup, or 1 facedown, refilling faceup from deck; you cannot draw with 8 cards in hand. Convoy: place 2-4 cards facedown as your truck convoy; you are Smuggler. Each opponent may play a Prohi to inspect: Lieutenant inspects 1, Captain 2, Major 3. Highest rank wins inspection, tie first played. If no inspectors, convoy scores facedown to your warehouse. If inspected, you may offer any cards from hand as bribe in multiple rounds. If bribe accepted, your convoy scores to your warehouse, Inspector scores bribe facedown to his warehouse and reclaims his Prohi. If bribe rejected or none offered, Inspector may let it pass and scores his Prohi, or inspects. During inspection reveal cards one by one: if any Illegal Goods revealed, Inspector steals entire convoy to his warehouse; if only Legal Goods or a Prohi is revealed, convoy succeeds and Smuggler scores it plus captures Inspector's Prohi to hand. Unrevealed convoy cards stay secret. Game ends when deck empty and <4 faceup remain, then each gets one final turn, or all pass. Score warehouses: Legal $1000, Illegal $4000, Lieutenant $3000, Captain $4000, Major $5000, plus Prohis left in hand $1000/$2000/$3000, minus $4000 per Illegal left in hand.
rating_reason: Smuggling bluff negotiate inspection hidden goods fits engine.
reasons: capability: trading_between_players: no mechanism for a player to propose and a player to accept an exchange
